title: Ohio court protects homeowners' lakeside peninsula from a company's land claim after a 2019 survey
summary_full: An Ohio court has definitively ruled that homeowners can retain their claim to a lakeside peninsula amid contentious property disputes. This decision followed a challenge from 1643 Limited LLC, which sought to redefine its property borders based on a 2019 survey. Although the appeals court confirmed the company's ownership of the adjacent beach, it firmly denied its rights over the peninsula itself, requiring a narrowed property description for the LLC.
